name: deck
description: A control plane for coding agents working across repositories: workspace resolution, impact graph, decision toggles, and verification gates. Domain specifics arrive from extension packs as data, never as code.

workspace_root.title: Workspace root
workspace_root.description: Root of the repository collection deck manages. Used only when DECK_ROOT is unset and no pack marker matches.

packs.title: Extension pack directory
packs.description: Directory holding a deck extension pack (config/toggles.yaml, config/gates.yaml, templates/). Optional; the descriptor can also name packs.
